lead.event: Bayan Resources records a Rp1.7 trillion negotiation-market share transaction
lead.headline: BYAN records Rp1.7 trillion share transaction on negotiation market
lead.blurb: A single negotiation-market trade covered 6.5 million lots of Bayan Resources shares at Rp2,588 per share on 15 October, according to RTI data. No official explanation was available at the time of writing. The price matched the 7 October transfer by Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low to Jhonlin Baratama, which left the company with a 30.25% stake in Bayan Resources.

deals_control.event: Low Tuck Kwong buys 100 million Bayan Resources shares on October 14
deals_control.headline: BYAN: Low Tuck Kwong buys 100 million shares on 14 October
deals_control.blurb: The negotiated-market transaction cost Rp1.12 trillion and lifted his direct holding to 3.42 billion shares, or 10.25% of voting rights, from 9.95%. It followed Jhonlin Baratama’s 7 October purchase of 30.25% of BYAN, after which Low said he would retain control.

deals_control.event: Bumi Resources completes its acquisition of Australia's Loyal Metals
deals_control.headline: BUMI completes acquisition of Loyal Metals for AU$79.07 million
deals_control.blurb: Bumi Resources acquired all 175.71 million shares through subsidiary Bumi Resources Australia on 4 September. The purchase opens access to copper, gold and other critical minerals.

deals_control.event: Era Media Sejahtera plans a rights issue to fund expansion and an INET stake
deals_control.headline: DOOH plans 154.78 billion-share rights issue for AI expansion and INET stake
deals_control.blurb: SSPACE plans up to 154.78 billion new shares at Rp10 each, with up to 95.24% dilution for non-participants. Proceeds would repay a loan from controlling shareholder Sinergi Internasional Investama and fund a subsidiary’s 29.88% INET stake. Shareholders will consider an initial drawdown of up to Rp2 trillion on 9 November.

deals_control.event: Maxglory Capital deal will change Wilton Makmur's indirect controlling shareholder
deals_control.headline: Maxglory's US$69.91 million deal could change SQMI's indirect control
deals_control.blurb: Maxglory Capital signed agreements with Wilton Resources on 9 October to subscribe for shares and convertible bonds, with combined gross proceeds of about US$69.91 million. If completed, the transactions are expected to transfer control of Wilton Resources, SQMI's controlling parent, to Maxglory.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Alamtri Minerals issues Rp2 trillion bonds through Maruwai Coal
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ADMR issues Rp2 trillion bonds through Maruwai Coal
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Maruwai Coal listed Series A at 8% for 370 days and Series B at 8.75% for three years on 12 October. About 81% of proceeds will fund CHPP 2. Alamtri Minerals said the issuance will increase consolidated liabilities without materially affecting business continuity.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Waskita Beton Precast plans debt-to-equity conversion through a private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: WSBP plans Rp1.72 trillion debt-to-equity conversion via private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Waskita Beton Precast plans to issue up to 119.98 million Series C shares at Rp50.81 each, bringing the planned total to 33.83 billion shares. An extraordinary general meeting on 2 October failed to reach a quorum, and shareholders are scheduled to consider the ceiling increase on 23 October, subject to approval.

earnings_guidance.event: Maybank Sekuritas cuts its 2026 Jakarta Composite Index target
earnings_guidance.headline: Maybank Sekuritas cuts 2026 JCI target to 6,900
earnings_guidance.blurb: The broker also cut projected core earnings growth for covered issuers to 8.3% from 9.4%, citing a slower recovery and persistent liquidity pressure. It set a 2027 index target of 7,700, implying 11.6% upside, after the JCI fell 32.07% to 5,943.02 by 14 October.

earnings_guidance.event: Global Digital Niaga reports first-half 2026 revenue growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BELI reports first-half revenue growth to Rp14.83 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Blibli said growth was led by the institutional segment alongside physical stores. Take Rate rose to 9% from 8.6%, while operating expenses as a share of TPV fell to 6.3% from 7.2%, lifting consolidated EBITDA as a share of TPV by 170 bps year on year.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI Danareksa raises Bukit Asam profit estimates for 2026 and 2027
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI Danareksa raises PTBA profit estimates to Rp5.4 trillion for 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI Danareksa projects Bukit Asam net profit at Rp4.4 trillion in 2027, down 18% year on year as prices and margins normalize. It raised thermal coal average selling price assumptions by 27.4% for 2026 and 19.3% for 2027, and sees up to 16% potential return from price upside and estimated dividends.

earnings_guidance.event: Waskita Beton Precast reports a wider nine-month 2026 net loss
earnings_guidance.headline: WSBP reports a 26.69% wider nine-month net loss of Rp410.77 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Waskita Beton Precast's revenue fell 7.75% to Rp1.07 trillion and gross profit declined to Rp129.83 billion. Finance costs rose to Rp234.22 billion. Its accumulated deficit reached Rp10.4 trillion, while its equity deficit widened to Rp2.36 trillion from Rp1.96 trillion.

macro_flows.event: IEA reports surging global oil prices and tightening diesel supply
macro_flows.headline: IEA reports Brent rises 13% as diesel availability falls 1.7 million bpd
macro_flows.blurb: North Sea Dated crude rose $26.17 per barrel month on month to $116.89 in September and reached about $134 when the report was compiled. The IEA projects 2026 supply will average 100.7 million bpd, down 5.8 million bpd, before rising 7.7 million bpd in 2027.
